request.title: Post a "Show HN" under your own name?
request.why: Posting speaks for the owner in public; an agent must not post or choose the identity.
request.context: A 180-word draft is attached. Posting takes about 15 minutes, and replying to comments in the first 2 hours matters most.

options.label: Company account
options.detail: Keeps a personal name out, but new accounts get less trust.

request.rec_reason: Individual makers get more trust and engagement in this community.

evidence.claim: Show HN expects the poster to have made the thing and to answer questions.

request.undo: The post can be deleted, but copies may persist.

artifacts.title: Show HN draft
artifacts.content:
Show HN: An open payload format for asking humans to decide

Agents ask us things all day…

response.note: Before I post: list the 5 most likely objections in the comments and how I'd answer each.
